layout_sources: https://pypi.org/project/ubs-transactions-csv-parser/ (README and AccountExportData.from_csv, 2025: eight "Label:;value;" rows (account number, IBAN, from, until, opening balance, closing balance, valued in, number of transactions), an empty row, the 14-column header ending in ";", ISO dates, a trade time, Debit negative "-137.00", a Balance on every line, Description1 quoted with ";" inside)
https://pypi.org/project/ubs-to-ynab/ (account format: first line "Account number", header found by "Trade date", Debit/Credit plain numbers, Description1-3; read as UTF-8 first)

https://github.com/bank2ynab/bank2ynab/blob/master/bank2ynab.conf [CH UBS Checking account - Alternative 1] (the German header Abschlussdatum;Abschlusszeit;Buchungsdatum;Valutadatum;Währung;Belastung;Gutschrift;Einzelbetrag;Saldo;Transaktions-Nr.;Beschreibung1;Beschreibung2;Beschreibung3;Fussnoten; Header Rows = 10; "Belastung is a negative number"; %Y-%m-%d)
notes: UBS digital banking CSV, German: eight rows of "Label:;value;" above the table (Kontonummer, IBAN, Von, Bis, Anfangssaldo, Schlusssaldo, Bewertet in, Anzahl Transaktionen), an empty row, then the header; every row ends in ";"; ISO dates; Belastung negative and Gutschrift positive with a dot decimal and no thousands mark; Saldo after every line; Beschreibung1 holds name;street;town in quotes. The German labels of the rows above the table are translated from the documented English ones ("Opening balance:" -> "Anfangssaldo:"). UTF-8 without BOM, CRLF and oldest-first (as in the parser's example) assumed. Opening and closing as stated above the table.
